messages:
maria: quick check-in — proposal to emit partial-credit events for streaming / long-lived requests instead of waiting for finalization. idea is to assign credits incrementally as microbatches commit to the ledger so customer balances reflect near-real-time usage. @kevin @sophia any immediate red flags? :thinking:
kevin: high-level i like it for UX. main worry is reconciliation/dedupe when the finalization event arrives. we can't accidentally double-charge. also more write volume to the ledger.
sophia: agree on dedupe. thought: emit both partial and final but include a provenance pointer `finalizes_event_id` on the partials. canonicalizer/finalizer can mark partials as superseded during reconcile. that gives audit trail.
tim: two operational concerns — (1) client-visible balances need consistent ordering (we may need per-tenant sequence numbers), (2) cross-region reordering for streaming sessions. how do we keep real-time decrements correct if a late microbatch arrives?
maria: good points. my current thinking: per-session monotonic seq + event_id. ledger accepts partials as provisional and final as authoritative. reconciliation job will move provisional -> settled state. for real-time balances, serve provisional balances with a warning flag in the console/API until settled.
kevin: what about cost? rough ballpark: +10-15% write amplification, but reduces tail-credit spikes and customer complaints. Also enables better burst smoothing.
sophia: schema suggestion (proto/json) — partial events are small and append-only, final event carries aggregation and proof. sample event for discussion:
```json
{
  "event_type": "partial_credit",
  "event_id": "evt_abc123",
  "session_id": "sess_42",
  "seq": 7,
  "tokens": 120,
  "finalizes_event_id": null,
  "provisional": true,
  "timestamp": 1718001200
}
```
and then finalizer emits:
```json
{
  "event_type": "final_credit",
  "event_id": "evt_final_abc123",
  "session_id": "sess_42",
  "seq": 7,
  "tokens": 125,
  "finalizes_event_id": "evt_abc123",
  "provisional": false,
  "timestamp": 1718001280
}
```
kevin: dedupe approach looks sane. we need a clear SLA for when provisional -> settled happens (e.g., 10s / 1min). also backlog strategy if finalizer fails.
maria: propose SLA target: provisional visible immediately, auto-settle within 30s for hosted region default. extra-long sessions can set lower guarantees in Dedicated. will add options in config.
sophia: one more thought — telemetry: tag partials with a sampling fingerprint for downstream audit/eviction heuristics. helps when we compact ledger later.
tim: operational playbook idea: if finalizer backlog grows, temporarily mark new partials as provisional-only and hold final issuance until backlog clears, to avoid inconsistent settles. need alerting.
metering-bot: NOTE: ingest schema version bump required (v3) if we add `provisional` + `finalizes_event_id`. Please open an RFC and update schema registry.
maria: thanks. i'll open RFC and include reconciliation recipe + cost estimate. filing now: https://rfc.internal/PR-1234 :thumbsup:
kevin: ack. will review RFC tomorrow.
sophia: thanks — will add proofs for audit logs in the doc.
thread_summary: proposal to add partial-credit events for streaming requests; discussion of dedupe, provisional vs final events, schema samples, SLA, operational playbook, metrics, and RFC next steps
